The randomized nature of Nameless Fool's ability can make it difficult to build around, and this will become more true as new Darkanas are added. There are effectively two ways of playing the Fool: recklessly rushing to one's own death in the early game so as to max out on Darkana early, or playing as normal and treating the ability as a bonus rather than something to actively strive towards.
